question: Who among the following founded his Kuchipudi Art Academy at Madras in 1963?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Vempati Chinna Satyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vempati Chinna Satyam** was a renowned exponent of the **Kuchipudi dance form**, which is a classical dance originating from **Andhra Pradesh, India.**
 
• He founded the **Kuchipudi Art Academy** in **Madras (now Chennai)** in the year **1963**.
 
• The academy played a significant role in promoting and preserving the **Kuchipudi dance tradition** globally.
 
• Vempati Chinna Satyam is credited with transforming Kuchipudi into a major classical dance form by introducing innovations and standardizing its techniques.
 
• He choreographed several iconic dance dramas based on **Hindu mythology and epics**, such as **"Sri Krishna Leela Tarangini," "Kalyana Srinivasam,"** and **"Rukmini Kalyanam."**
 
• Vempati Chinna Satyam trained numerous students, some of whom have become celebrated Kuchipudi dancers and contributed to the propagation of the art form worldwide.
 
• He received prestigious awards such as the **Padma Bhushan** and the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship** for his contributions to Indian classical dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kamalakar Kameshwar Rao**__

 __
 
• There is no significant record of Kamalakar Kameshwar Rao founding any major dance academy or being directly associated with the **Kuchipudi dance form.**
 
 
 
• **Lakshmi Narayan Shastri**__
 __
 
• While Lakshmi Narayan Shastri was likely a notable figure, there is no evidence linking him to the establishment of the **Kuchipudi Art Academy.**
 
 
 
• **Raja Reddy**__
 
 
• **Raja Reddy** is a renowned dancer known for his contributions to **Kuchipudi**, but he did not found the Kuchipudi Art Academy in Madras.
 
• Raja Reddy and his family are celebrated performers who have popularized Kuchipudi globally.
